evidence.quote: A lightweight heterogeneous graph encoder maps a curated 62,507-node biomedical KG (genes, proteins, GO terms, drugs, pathways; 11 relation types) into compact virtual tokens prepended to each cell sentence.

representation_rationale.summary: Virtual KG tokens provide structured biological context with compact sequence overhead.

evidence.quote: The LM never reads the graph as text; instead, for each gene g ( i ) in a cell sentence we read its row e g ( i ) ∈ R 256 from E and lift it into the 5120dim LM hidden space with a small KGProjector MLP

representation_rationale.summary: The graph is connected to the language model through projected virtual tokens while retaining a text interface.

evidence.quote: without consuming the context budget that a textual triple dump would.

representation_rationale.summary: Prefix virtual tokens avoid the context-budget cost of representing graph triples as text.

evidence.quote: Each cell is encoded as a Cell Sentence [Levine et al., 2024]: a ranked list of HGNC gene symbols that any LM tokeniser can read directly.

representation_rationale.summary: Ranked gene symbols can be read directly by a language-model tokenizer.

evidence.quote: Rank correlates almost linearly with log-expression ( R 2 ≈ 0 . 90 ), so a lightweight inversion MLP can recover expression magnitudes from a predicted rank list when needed.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors motivate ranked gene symbols through their strong relationship with log-expression and recoverability of expression magnitudes.

evidence.quote: The two-layer design (rather than a single linear 256 → 5120 projection) is motivated by the need to interpolate from the compact, geometrically structured KG manifold into the much higher-dimensional LM hidden space

representation_rationale.summary: The two-layer projector is intended to interpolate from the compact structured KG manifold into the higher-dimensional language-model space.

evidence.quote: First, the KG is a static snapshot; novel gene-disease associations require re-running Stage 0, and future work will explore dynamic KG retrieval.

representation_rationale.summary: The static KG requires rerunning KG training to incorporate novel gene-disease associations.

evidence.quote: clinical samples (tumor biopsies, organoids, spatial transcriptomics) with lower gene-detection depth fall below our 500-gene QC threshold and require further adaptation before clinical deployment.

representation_rationale.summary: The input and quality-control requirements may exclude lower-depth clinical samples.
